name: yxj-paper-os
description: Reader-first, evidence-bound academic paper design and revision with four-skeleton alignment, positive writing, Chinese-English authorial expression, and canonical artifact verification.

interface.shortDescription: Reader-first academic paper design and revision.
interface.longDescription: YXJ Paper OS designs or revises one academic paper within a non-negotiable evidence boundary. It aligns scientific, reader, section, and visual skeletons when structure is at issue, makes established value visible without hiding necessary qualifications, preserves logical and navigational relations, and verifies affected artifacts. It retains repository authority, scoped writeback, and matched-venue calibration without adding workflow paperwork or rewriting shared Git history.
capabilities: Explicit assess, design, revise, and audit intent
New-paper creation baseline or existing-paper delta re-entry
Conditional scientific, reader, section, and visual skeleton alignment
Earliest reader-path divergence and recurrence repair
Matched-venue functional writing calibration from verified exemplars
Positive writing with minimal sufficient defense and a scientific evidence ceiling
Context-sensitive Chinese-English authorial expression with approved voice preservation
Repository authority and stable author directions
Relation-aware displays and bundle verification from editable sources
Direct writeback with cross-surface impact closure
defaultPrompt: Design a reader-first paper argument from the current scientific evidence.
Revise this paper, close affected surfaces, and verify the canonical artifact.
Calibrate this paper against matched-venue exemplars without changing its science.
